problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266767/assets/fcddcd5295d9adfa3755afa206fa546b4440f7a5443330fe99025568303fbf61.png)

Calculate $y$ rounded to two decimal places.
worked_solution:
First, let's label all of the vertices and sides of our triangle.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266767/assets/5f7338337e4c6beb9f9fdec8ad952e940162c85058150101c1d083bc83a081f5.png)

The Law of Sines states that

$$
\frac{x}{\operatorname{sin}⁡X}=\frac{y}{\operatorname{sin}⁡Y}=\frac{z}{\operatorname{sin}⁡Z}.
$$

In this case, we have

$$
m∠X={78}^{∘},\,m∠Y={36}^{∘},\,x=16,
$$

and consequently

$$
\frac{16}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{78}^{∘}}=\frac{y}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{36}^{∘}}.
$$

To solve for $y,$ we multiply both sides by $\operatorname{sin}⁡{36}^{∘}$ to give

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{sin}⁡{36}^{∘}\times \frac{16}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{78}^{∘}} & =\operatorname{sin}⁡{36}^{∘}\times \frac{y}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{36}^{∘}} \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡{36}^{∘}\times \frac{16}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{78}^{∘}} & =\cancel{\operatorname{sin}⁡{36}^{∘}}\times \frac{y}{\cancel{\operatorname{sin}⁡{36}^{∘}}} \\ y & =\operatorname{sin}⁡{36}^{∘}\times \frac{16}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{78}^{∘}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, $\operatorname{sin}⁡{36}^{∘}≈0.587\,79$ and $\operatorname{sin}⁡{78}^{∘}≈0.978\,15,$ both rounded to five decimal places to avoid rounding error. This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =\operatorname{sin}⁡{36}^{∘}\times \frac{16}{\operatorname{sin}⁡{78}^{∘}} \\  & ≈0.587\,79\times \frac{16}{0.978\,15} \\  & ≈\frac{0.587\,79\times 16}{0.978\,15} \\  & ≈\frac{9.404\,64}{0.978\,15} \\  & ≈9.61,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to two decimal places.

In this case, we have m∠X=78∘,m∠Y=36∘,x=16, and consequently 16sin⁡78∘=ysin⁡36∘.

To solve for y, we multiply both sides by sin⁡36∘ to give sin⁡36∘×16sin⁡78∘=sin⁡36∘×ysin⁡36∘sin⁡36∘×16sin⁡78∘=sin⁡36∘×ysin⁡36∘y=sin⁡36∘×16sin⁡78∘.

Now, sin⁡36∘≈0.58779 and sin⁡78∘≈0.97815, both rounded to five decimal places to avoid rounding error. This gives y=sin⁡36∘×16sin⁡78∘≈0.58779×160.97815≈0.58779×160.97815≈9.404640.97815≈9.61, rounded to two decimal places.
